Knowledge base plugins on this computer:
kb     $HOME/bin/study-shelf -u $HOME/study/go-concurrency/kb.py
  ! Its arguments inside the Study home are allowed: your agent can change what they name.
notes  $HOME/bin/notes-kb '=serve' --root=$HOME/notes
  ! argument 2 of its command, "--root=$HOME/notes", names something inside the Study home, $HOME/notes, or reached through it, where your agent can write, and the plugin was not registered to allow that, so study does not use it: register it again with study knowledge-base add notes --replace, without that argument or with --allow-study-home-arguments
Registry: $HOME/.config/lamplight/knowledge-base-plugins.json
